standard.summary: 配置 Weights & Biases（WandB）训练追踪：API Key 验证身份，run_name 设置本次训练的显示名称。训练过程中的 loss、LR、速度等指标自动上传到 WandB 看板。
standard.effect: 开启后可以在 wandb.ai 实时查看训练曲线、对比不同实验、存储训练配置历史。
standard.whenToUse: 需要系统化追踪和对比多次训练实验时使用。适合调参阶段（对比不同 LR/rank/optimizer 的 loss 曲线）。
standard.avoidWhen: wandb_api_key 不要硬编码到配置文件（有泄露风险），建议通过环境变量或 wandb login 命令设置。不需要远程追踪时保持 None（默认只记录本地日志）。

standard_en.summary: Configures Weights & Biases (WandB) training tracking: the API key authenticates you and run_name sets the display name for this run. Metrics such as loss, LR and speed are uploaded to the WandB dashboard automatically during training.
standard_en.effect: Once enabled you can watch the training curves live on wandb.ai, compare experiments, and keep a history of training configurations.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need to track and compare many training experiments systematically. It suits the tuning stage (comparing the loss curves of different LR/rank/optimizer choices).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not hard-code wandb_api_key into a configuration file (it risks leaking); setting it through an environment variable or the wandb login command is advisable. Leave it None when you do not need remote tracking (by default only local logs are kept).

advanced.principle: WandB 集成通过 wandb.init() + wandb.log() 实现，log_prefix 给所有指标添加前缀（方便同一项目下多次训练的指标区分）。log_tracker_config 指定额外记录的配置字段（默认记录全部训练配置）。
advanced.tradeoffs: WandB 上传需要网络连接，中断训练时离线缓存的数据会在恢复网络后自动同步。付费计划限制大量数据上传；开源项目可免费使用基本功能。

advanced_en.principle: WandB integration is implemented via wandb.init() + wandb.log(); log_prefix prepends a prefix to all metrics (handy for distinguishing runs under the same project). log_tracker_config specifies extra config fields to record (by default all training config is recorded).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: WandB upload needs network access; when training is interrupted, offline-cached data syncs automatically once the network recovers. Paid plans limit large data uploads; open-source projects can use the basic features free.
